changes: Smart routing: within a Codex priority tier, the account with the most quota at risk per hour before its soonest reset (the least left in any window, over the hours to that reset) is used first; accounts within 1% share requests and a spent window skips the account

Managed account pools (OpenCode Go and other API-key accounts that fail over to each other) are ordered the same way from each account's cached quota reading; accounts without a fresh reading come next and spent ones last; pinned requests, the 429 cooldown and failover are unchanged
